messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: VeloFoods dedicated cluster flips to customer traffic tomorrow 08:00 PST. Need final OK on quota priming plan, autoscale limits, and our smoke/load checklist.
jonah_se: I prepared priming: prefix warm + tokenizer init. Plan: 40k short queries over 20m then 10k medium-length to warm KV/embeds.
kevin_sre: Confirm reserved GPUs for week1? We also need a safe lower bound for autoscale to avoid cold starts.
alyssa_pm: Committed: 5x A100-equivalent reserved. Burst pool +2 for 1.5h allowed. SLA target shared by customer: p50 < 120ms for small text-gen.
sam_ops: Proposed run phases: quick smoke (10m), controlled ramp (30m), steady soak (2h). Target sustain 100 rps during soak, ramp spikes to 400rps.
maria_cs: Customer asked for instant fallback to hosted for critical routes if throttling/latency spikes. Can we implement a staged fallback?
kevin_sre: Yes. Route policy: on error rate >= 3% OR p99 > 600ms for 90s -> shift 25% to hosted, monitor 2m, escalate increments if needed. Policy id rp-2d7f attached.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: routing-policy/velo-fallback-2026 (id: rp-2d7f). Status: awaiting eng-sre review.
jonah_se: Load command I'll run locally (internal tool):
```
./loadrun --target=100 --ramp=30m --burst=400 --duration=2h --prime-prefixes=40000 --concurrency=32 --model=redwood-v1
```
oliver_eng: Add a tokenizer warm call before load: hit /v1/health/init and a few longer prompts to precompute kv cache. Avoid starting with long-context cold hits.
kevin_sre: Also do a small unique-prefix warm for embeddings: 3k unique short calls to populate embedding lookup cache.
sam_ops: I'll add that as step 0. I'll push a runbook snippet and the Datadog dashboard linkage. Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, queue_depth, gpu_util, token/sec, kv_hit_rate, embed_hit_ratio.
alyssa_pm: Create alerting: page on p99 > 400ms for 3m, slack notify for p99 > 300ms for 5m. Sales to be notified if sustained errors > 1%. Tag alerts to maria_cs and me.
maria_cs: Agree. Also request the customer provide 2-3 production-weighted payloads to validate quality during soak. We'll log any quality regressions in the evals board.
jonah_se: I'll upload priming script gist after I finish minor tweaks. ETA +30m.
sam_ops: Dry-run scheduled at 07:10 PST (internal only). Live cutover at 08:00 if dry-run green. I'll paste run logs here. :thumbsup:
kevin_sre: I'll be on-call and in this channel during the window. If routing policy flips, we'll rollback autoscale changes and open incident if errors persist.
maria_cs: Ownership checklist: priming script = jonah_se; run + metrics = sam_ops; routing/autoscale = kevin_sre; comms = maria_cs + alyssa_pm.
jonah_se: Confirmed. One more: I'll pre-pull quant tables and container layers on nodes to reduce cold-start time.
sam_ops: Noted. Will include a quick node readiness probe in the runbook.
maria_cs: Thanks all. Reminder: capture any anecdotal customer feedback during soak and flag anything that might affect renewal conversations.
jonah_se: Posting priming gist now -> https://internal.gist/priming/velofoods-priming.sh
sam_ops: Dry-run logs: starting at 07:10 PST. Will paste results after completion.
maria_cs: Great. Meet here at 07:55 for go/no-go.
